# Accurate enough for which decision? (M10)

Swap a fixed multiset of forecast errors between eight moments. MAE and RMSE stay fixed; asymmetric threshold-decision loss changes. Three fictional contexts cover acting on opportunities, investigating low operating headroom, and adding review capacity. Low headroom triggers at or below the threshold; the other contexts trigger at or above it. Equality counts as warranted action in both directions.

Switching context applies its actual values, threshold and loss assumptions while preserving error positions. Pinned allocations replay under the same current context and edits. Undo restores a changed context and custom assumptions. Legacy saves become the original opportunity context without changing values. Drag/touch or native swap selectors, local saving and Markdown with embedded JSON remain.

The same swap between moments 1 and 6 reduces opportunity loss from 14 to 11 but increases review-capacity loss from 3 to 13, with MAE 7.5 in both contexts. This is a hindsight error-allocation experiment, not a forecasting method. Indices and losses are fictional, not physical percentages or calibrated costs. Independent decisions omit resource constraints, time coupling and asset valuation. Tests cover invariant accuracy, directional thresholds, ranking reversal, legacy state and matched baselines.
